answer.summary: Buy the coins whose 20-day price gain is strongest compared with all other coins.
how_it_works: ts_delta(close, 20) measures how much each coin's price has risen or fallen over the last 20 days.
zscore(...) compares that 20-day gain with the other coins today, so positive scores mean stronger-than-average momentum.
The portfolio favours the highest positive scores, matching a 2-to-4-week holding horizon.
answer.watch_out: This strategy loses money when recent winners suddenly reverse and momentum crashes, especially after sharp market turns.
